youtube.title: Flamingos Aren't Born Pink 🦩 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Flamingos are born grey.

Flamingo chicks hatch grey. Adults turn pink from carotenoid pigments in the algae and shrimp they eat, which their bodies deposit in their feathers. Without that diet, they slowly fade to white.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
